title: Recover Arcadia host services and protected transport
problem: The managed worker may be stopped, the Go-broker profile may be stale, or preservation and Go routing may lack a fresh heartbeat. That prevents safe session-to-session continuation.
desired_effect: The managed worker, preservation transport, and Go transport are all freshly verified before Arcadia resumes protected continuation.

never_does: Fetch, merge, push, checkout, or otherwise change Git state
Deploy, publish, settle governance, or bypass protected preservation

success.effect: Protected preservation and Go routing are ready for a fresh Arcadia continuation.
success.next: Start a new session and run arcadia advance.

failure.effect: The script exits non-zero and writes a failure handoff plus its complete run log under runs/<timestamp-pid>/.
failure.next: Give the handoff and run log to Arcadia. A coding agent should diagnose the first failing command and generate a narrower follow-up script only if safe.
